prompt.project_info: Hyper-realistic eye-level mirror selfie of one original adult woman during Holi in a grand ancient Indian courtyard, captured in bright golden-hour sunlight through colored dust.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman smiling warmly while holding a smartphone with a patterned case. She wears a traditional white cotton Salwar Kameez heavily splattered with vibrant Holi pigments in magenta, cyan, turmeric yellow and electric green. Her blonde hair is messy in a festival style, wet with colored water and dry powder, and her fair skin has realistic gulal smears across the cheeks and forehead. Do not reproduce Sydney Sweeney or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a single-subject mirror selfie perspective at eye level, with the smartphone naturally visible and the patterned case readable only as a pattern, not a logo. Set the scene in a grand ancient Indian Haveli courtyard with intricate Rajasthani sandstone carvings, arched balconies and temple-style pillars. Fill the background with adult festival participants playing Holi, flying colored dust, dancing and traditional marigold decorations. Keep the subject clear against the lively courtyard.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural golden-hour sunlight filters through colored dust clouds, creating warm highlights and realistic color bounce on the white cotton fabric and skin. Preserve a festive, energetic, crowded Holi atmosphere with vibrant warm saturation and realistic powder texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic photography, eye-level mirror selfie perspective, 8K-style detail, natural smartphone optics, realistic phone reflection, hands, cotton fabric, colored powder, sandstone, dust and marigold texture, no text, logos or watermark.
